items.title: Respecting Intellectual Property and Data Ownership (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Respecting Intellectual Property and Data Ownership (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Intellectual property se murad takhleeqi kaam hai, jaise software, music ya tehreer (writing). Data ownership (data ki milkiyat) se murad apni zaati maloomat par control ka haq hai. In haqooq ke ehtram ka matlab hai ke ijazat ke baghair kisi ka kaam copy, share ya use na karein. Zaati aur hassas maloomat mehfooz rakhni chahiye aur us ka ghalat istemal nahi hona chahiye. Intellectual property aur data ka qanooni aur akhlaqi ehtram insaf ko barhata hai aur banane walon (creators) aur users dono ki hifazat karta hai.

blocks.caption: Do huqooq
rows: Apni zaati maloomat par control ka haq
Ijazat ke baghair copy, share ya use nahi
Zaati aur hassas maloomat ka ghalat istemal nahi

blocks.prompt: Kisi aur ka gaana ijazat ke baghair apni video mein lagana kis haq ki khilaf-warzi hai?
blocks.explanation: Intellectual property (takhleeqi kaam ka haq) ki; yeh copyright laws aur digital ethics dono ke khilaf hai.

items: Intellectual property: software, music, writing jaisa takhleeqi kaam.
Data ownership: zaati maloomat par haq; dono ka ehtram creators aur users ko bachata hai.
